goal: Quantify recursive repair acceleration across recent NouGenShards PRs
body: Evidence from the recent MCP hardening run shows repeated break -> diagnosis -> stronger invariant cycles. Please audit the most recent 72 NouGenShards PRs with available create/merge timestamps and incident references, cluster them by failure class, and compute repair-latency compression where a later PR is an explicit follow-up to an earlier failed fix. Preserve counterexamples. Do not force a 2x claim: report median/mean MTTR by sequence and confidence. Anchor examples already verified: #149 -> #154; #152; #160 -> #162 -> #163 -> #164 -> #166 -> #167 -> #168; #156 -> #157 -> #158 -> #170 -> #171; #172. Done when the fleet has an evidence-backed answer to whether recursive lookback measurably shortened repair cycles.

relay.note: Asks for an evidence-backed audit of ~72 recent NouGenShards PRs (failure clustering, repair-latency compression, MTTR by sequence) with named PR chains (#149-#172) to test. This is a GitHub PR-history analysis task beyond relay-watch's file-only reach. Queued to the blade/claude-cli lane. Note: this leg's mention of 'incident references' is a requested audit field, not an active incident — not escalating.

Reconciled complete against explicit acceptance evidence in the linked answer: shipped implementation, focused tests, and live proof where required. Optional follow-ons remain separate and do not invalidate this leg.
